## Project Overview
Research project (ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL) running algorithmic campaigns to improve IFR (Initial Feasibility Rate) for a routing/scheduling optimizer. Currently working on RC-003 report with v13 campaign results across setA-01 through setA-20.

## Completed Work
- Fixed RC-001A3: truncation → routing failure (correctness fix)
- Fixed RC-001A4: all-slots saturation tracking (correctness fix)
- Fixed RC-001A5: ECMP fallback for infeasible constructions (robustness fix)
- Verified all three fixes via v12 campaign
- Wrote RC-003 report with corrected framings
- Softened two statements in report per review feedback
- Updated RC-003 report with setA-13–20 results and aggregate IFR statistics (mean/median/min/max per arm)
- v13 campaign running; 18/20 sets complete, setA-19 and setA-20 pending

## Key Technical Decisions
- v13 campaign output file: `/tmp/rc003_v13.txt`
- Report location: `docs/roadef/RC003_IFR_IMPROVEMENT_REPORT.md`
- Campaign uses Arm A and Arm B per set (50 trials each)
- IFR = fraction of trials with valid initial solution
- setA-02 Arm B: known hard case — current constructor+ECMP cannot find feasible initial solution; GA evolution is one path but not proven necessary
- IFR=0 cases attributed to heuristic limitations rather than any known defect

## Relevant Files & Code
- `/tmp/rc003_v13.txt` — live campaign output
- `docs/roadef/RC003_IFR_IMPROVEMENT_REPORT.md` — main report (VSCode visible)

- `scripts/rp408b_analysis.py` — open in editor

## Current Status
setA-19 Arm A completed (confirmed by grep showing 19 "Arm A:" lines). setA-19 Arm B still running. A new `sleep 60 && grep` command is running to check progress on setA-19 and setA-20. Previous snapshot showed IFR=0/50 for both arms of both sets, but waiting for confirmed final results before updating the report.
